evidence.point: The client has 3 counters and 138 invoices, placing them in the 91.5th and 99.8th percentiles for these metrics respectively.
Consumption data shows significant volatility, with a mean consumption of 628.5148 (96.7th percentile) and a maximum consumption of 4033.0 (98.6th percentile).
There is a recorded reconciliation mismatch (n_recon_mismatch = 1) and a maximum reconciliation gap of 1564.0.
Historical usage patterns indicate a maximum zero-consumption run of 21.0 months (97.4th percentile) and a maximum year-over-year drop of 1.0 (93.2th percentile).

onsite_checks: Inspect all 3 counters for physical tampering or bypass devices.
Verify the accuracy of current meter readings against the historical reconciliation gap of 1564.0.
Investigate the cause of the 21-month zero-consumption run to determine if it aligns with property vacancy or meter failure.
brief.uncertainty: While the model identifies high risk based on consumption volatility and reconciliation mismatches, there is no direct evidence of meter tampering provided in the snapshot; physical inspection is necessary to confirm the cause of the anomalies.
